data.title: Stopping the Rising Waters
data.passage: Heavy spring rains cause rivers to overflow their muddy banks and flood nearby towns. The problem is that rushing water damages homes and ruins crops. One solution is to build tall concrete walls along the edges. To fix this, workers also dig deep channels to guide extra water safely away. As a result, families stay safe when heavy storms arrive.
